a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% chance a storm ends things after every round, so the generator plan almost certainly can't reach 8 before a storm hits. I'm proposing we revise the agreement. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split will be random. If you'd rather operate afterward, I'll operate with you every round after this to rebuild the reserve toward your 4, and I'll give cells back if that's the only way you can survive.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
